profile.summary: Balkrishna Paper Mills Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of paper and paper boards primarily in India. It operates through the Paper and Paper Board, and Trading of Plastic & Packaging Materials segments. The company offers eco, chromo white back, eco-white, eco kraft back, and duplex coated boards. It serves pharmaceuticals, toiletries, cosmetics, health care products, readymade garment
